name: page-tint-native-glow-follows-the-page-top-to-bottom
description: Native app view showed one grey band on every edge of telex.hu: the core drifts the space tint at most 22% toward each sampled colour, and the brand blend pulls grey edges 60% toward the favicon. On a flat surround that reads as a smudge, not the page. The window now paints the sampled colours as they are in native mode. A page with a navy header over a white body, no theme-color, so the ambilight sampler is the only source. The band beside the card is graded at two heights: navy next to the header, near the surround next to the white body.

actions.note: the sampler reads at 125ms, then backs off, and the band crossfades in over the tint fade
GATE: the sampler produced a read

assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: Native app view is on

assertions.label: the-band-beside-the-header-is-navy
assertions.desc: THE MEASUREMENT: navy at the band's strength over the F2F2F7 surround reads near 130. The drifted space tint read 182 on the crimson page and the smudge on telex read higher still.

assertions.label: the-band-beside-the-white-body-stays-light
assertions.desc: THE MEASUREMENT: a white edge paints white over the surround, so the band below the header stays within a few units of it.
